summary: SID paths now start on the runway and follow the published initial-climb heading to its altitude-gated turn, including SLEEK2 runway 8 at KDEN.
releaseNotes: A departure now begins at the runway threshold, follows the runway centreline to the departure end, and continues on the published initial-climb heading before turning to the first fix.
The bundled FAA dataset keeps a no-fix heading leg's course and altitude instead of dropping it, and carries runway-end elevation so the altitude turn can be placed.
The initial climb is carried through SimBrief import, the route builder, the EFB, the map and the stored route, so every page draws the same departure.
The procedure note says when a turn is altitude-gated and when its lateral position is drawn at 500 ft/NM, rather than presenting a planning line as a published ground distance.
SLEEK2 runway 8 at KDEN no longer turns toward KIDNG at the threshold; it climbs on 082.5° to 5,934 ft before the right turn.
A procedure without a published heading course and altitude gets no synthetic turn point.
